check_connection.title: Check connection
check_connection.description: Confirm the API key works by listing the most recent call on the account. Returns the call count and at most one call. Use get_account_details for balance and account status.

limit.description: How many calls to return; 1 is enough to prove the key works.

output.description: total_count, count and the calls array.

get_account_details.title: Get account details
get_account_details.description: Return the account's status, billing details (current credit balance, refill settings) and total call count. Use before large call batches to check the balance is enough.

output.description: Account status, billing object and total_calls.

send_call.title: Send an AI phone call
send_call.description: Place an outbound AI phone call to one number. Give either a `task` prompt, a `pathway_id` or a `persona_id` to drive the conversation. Returns the call_id to poll with get_call. For many recipients at once use create_batch; for inbound agents configure update_inbound_number instead.
send_call.notes: Places a real, billed phone call.

phone_number.description: Number to call, E.164 format, e.g. +14155550123.

task.description: Prompt telling the agent who it is and what to accomplish. Omit when using pathway_id or persona_id.

pathway_id.description: Conversational pathway that drives the call instead of a task prompt.

pathway_version.description: Pathway version to use; defaults to the production version.

persona_id.description: Persona whose saved configuration is applied; fields in this request override it.

voice.description: Voice name (e.g. Karen) or voice id from list_voices. Defaults to Karen.

first_sentence.description: Exact sentence the agent opens with.

from.description: Caller number you own on Bland or your Twilio account, E.164.

language.description: Language code, e.g. babel-en (default), en-US, es, fr, de.

wait_for_greeting.description: Wait for the callee to speak first.

record.description: Record the call; the recording is then available via get_call_recording.

max_duration.description: Minutes after which the call is ended automatically (default 30).

start_time.description: Schedule the call: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS -HH:MM'. Omit to call now.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the call, e.g. America/New_York.

transfer_phone_number.description: Number the agent may transfer to when asked for a human.

transfer_list.description: Map of department name to phone number the agent can transfer to; `default` is the fallback.

interruption_threshold.description: How long in ms the agent waits before responding; higher is more patient (default 500).

block_interruptions.description: Ignore the callee talking over the agent.

noise_cancellation.description: Filter background noise from the callee's audio.

background_track.description: Background audio: office, cafe, restaurant, none.

ivr_mode.description: Set when the destination answers with a phone menu.

tools.description: Custom tool ids (TL-...) or knowledge base ids the agent may use during the call.

request_data.description: Key-value variables available to the prompt, pathway and tools.

metadata.description: Your own key-value data stored on the call and returned in webhooks.

dispositions.description: Outcome tags; after the call the AI picks one of them.

summary_prompt.description: Instructions for how the post-call summary is written.

citation_schema_ids.description: Citation schemas to run for post-call data extraction.

keywords.description: Words to boost in transcription, e.g. brand names.

webhook.description: URL that receives the call details when the call ends.

webhook_events.description: Live events to stream to the webhook, e.g. queue, call, tool, webhook, citations.

precall_dtmf_sequence.description: DTMF digits to play before the call starts (0-9, *, #, w for a pause).

encrypted_key.description: Encrypted key of a Bring-Your-Own-Twilio account, only when working with numbers from your own Twilio account.

output.description: status, message and the new call_id.

list_calls.title: List calls
list_calls.description: List calls dispatched by or received on the account, newest first, with filters for numbers, dates, batch, duration, inbound and completion. Returns call metadata only; use get_call for the transcript and summary of one call.

from_number.description: Only calls placed from this number.

to_number.description: Only calls placed to this number.

from.description: Start index (inclusive) of the result range, for paging.

to.description: End index of the result range, for paging.

start_date.description: Calls on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601).

end_date.description: Calls on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601).

created_at.description: Calls on exactly this date, YYYY-MM-DD; not combinable with start/end_date.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to interpret date-only filters.

completed.description: Only completed (true) or not completed (false) calls.

answered_by.description: Only calls answered by this type, e.g. human or voicemail.

duration_gt.description: Only calls longer than this many minutes.

duration_lt.description: Only calls shorter than this many minutes.

encrypted_key.description: Encrypted key of a Bring-Your-Own-Twilio account, only when working with numbers from your own Twilio account.

output.description: total_count, count and the calls array.

list_active_calls.title: List active calls
list_active_calls.description: List the organization's calls that are queued or in progress right now, with numbers, pathway and status. Use stop_call or transfer_active_call on the ids it returns.

org_id.description: Your Bland organization id, sent as the x-bland-org-id header.

get_call.title: Get call details
get_call.description: Get one call's full details: status, length, numbers, transcripts, concatenated transcript, summary, recording URL, variables, pathway logs, analysis and price. Use get_corrected_transcript for the higher-accuracy transcript.

encrypted_key.description: Encrypted key of a Bring-Your-Own-Twilio account, only when working with numbers from your own Twilio account.

output.description: The call object, including transcripts and summary.

get_corrected_transcript.title: Get corrected transcript
get_corrected_transcript.description: Get the corrected transcript Bland produces by re-transcribing the call recording, which is more accurate than the live transcript in get_call. Requires the call to have been recorded.

get_call_recording.title: Get call recording
get_call_recording.description: Download the audio recording of a call that was placed with record=true. Returns the audio stream (WAV by default, MP3 when content_type is audio/mpeg).

get_call_event_stream.title: Get call event stream
get_call_event_stream.description: Get the log of events that happened during a call (queueing, dialing, tool calls, webhooks, errors) with level, category and timestamp. Useful for debugging why a call failed.

output.description: Events with level, message, category and timestamp.

get_pathway_call_events.title: Get pathway call events
get_pathway_call_events.description: Get the ordered pathway events of a call run on a conversational pathway: node transitions, variable extractions and tool operations. Use for debugging a pathway's behaviour on a real call.

v.description: Event format version; 2 is the current format.

output.description: Pathway events with sequence, event_type, node_id and payload.

analyze_call.title: Analyze a call with AI
analyze_call.description: Ask questions about a finished call's transcript and get structured answers, e.g. whether an appointment was booked. `questions` is a list of [question, answer type] pairs. For reusable extraction across many calls use citation schemas instead.

goal.description: Overall purpose of the call, giving the analysis context.

questions.description: Pairs of [question, expected type], e.g. [["Who answered?", "string"], ["Did they agree?", "boolean"]].

stop_call.title: Stop an active call
stop_call.description: Hang up one call that is queued or in progress. Use stop_all_active_calls to end every call on the account.

call_id.description: Id of the active call to end.

stop_all_active_calls.title: Stop all active calls
stop_all_active_calls.description: Hang up every queued and in-progress call on the account at once. Returns how many calls were ended. For one call use stop_call.

transfer_active_call.title: Transfer an active call
transfer_active_call.description: Transfer a call that is in progress to another phone number, e.g. to a human agent. The call must currently be live.

listen_to_call.title: Listen to an active call
listen_to_call.description: Start a live-listen session for a call in progress. Returns a WebSocket URL that streams the call audio.

output.description: The listen session, including the WebSocket url.

get_postcall_webhook.title: Get post-call webhook
get_postcall_webhook.description: Get the post-call webhook delivery recorded for a call: the payload sent, the URL, response code and time. Use resend_postcall_webhooks to deliver it again.

create_postcall_webhooks.title: Send post-call webhooks to a URL
create_postcall_webhooks.description: Build and send the post-call webhook payload for the given calls to a URL you choose, e.g. to backfill a new endpoint. Use resend_postcall_webhooks to re-deliver to the originally configured URL.

call_ids.description: Unique call ids to send webhooks for.

resend_postcall_webhooks.title: Resend post-call webhooks
resend_postcall_webhooks.description: Re-deliver the post-call webhooks for the given calls to the webhook URL each call was configured with. Use create_postcall_webhooks to send to a different URL.

call_ids.description: Unique call ids to resend webhooks for.

create_batch.title: Create a call batch
create_batch.description: Dispatch a batch of outbound calls in one request. `global` holds settings shared by every call (it must include task or pathway_id); `call_objects` lists each recipient with at least phone_number and any per-call overrides. Returns the batch_id; track it with get_batch and get_batch_logs.

global.description: Settings applied to every call, same fields as send_call; must include task or pathway_id.

call_objects.description: One object per call, each with phone_number plus any send_call fields that override global.

description.description: Label shown in the dashboard, max 60 characters.

status_webhook.description: URL that receives batch lifecycle updates.

encrypted_key.description: Encrypted key of a Bring-Your-Own-Twilio account, only when working with numbers from your own Twilio account.

list_batches.title: List call batches
list_batches.description: List the organization's call batches with their base prompt, description, call objects and creation time. Use get_batch for one batch.

skip.description: How many batches to skip, for paging.

get_batch.title: Get a call batch
get_batch.description: Get one batch's metadata: base prompt, description, call objects and creation time. Use list_calls with batch_id to see the individual calls' results.

get_batch_logs.title: Get batch logs
get_batch_logs.description: Get the event log of a batch (dispatches, completions, failures) with timestamps and payloads, newest first by default.

take.description: How many log entries to return.

skip.description: How many entries to skip, for paging.

stop_batch.title: Stop a call batch
stop_batch.description: Stop a running or scheduled batch so no further calls from it are dispatched. Calls already in progress are not hung up; use stop_call for those.

batch_id.description: Id of the batch to stop.

list_pathways.title: List pathways
list_pathways.description: List every conversational pathway on the account, with name, description, nodes and edges. Use get_pathway for one pathway.

get_pathway.title: Get a pathway
get_pathway.description: Get one conversational pathway with its name, description, nodes and edges. Use get_pathway_version for a specific version.

output.description: The pathway with nodes and edges.

create_pathway.title: Create a pathway
create_pathway.description: Create an empty conversational pathway with a name and description. Returns the pathway_id; add nodes and edges with update_pathway, or use generate_pathway to have one built from a prompt.

update_pathway.title: Update a pathway
update_pathway.description: Update a pathway's name, description, nodes or edges. Nodes and edges replace the existing ones. To edit a saved version use update_pathway_version.

nodes.description: Node objects: {id, type (Default, End Call, Transfer Call, Knowledge Base, Webhook...), data: {name, prompt|text, isStart...}}.

delete_pathway.title: Delete a pathway
delete_pathway.description: Permanently delete a conversational pathway. Calls and numbers that use it will stop working with it.

pathway_id.description: Id of the pathway to delete.

generate_pathway.title: Generate a pathway from a prompt
generate_pathway.description: Start an asynchronous job that builds a full conversational pathway from a detailed description (at least 100 characters). Returns a jobId; poll get_pathway_generation_status for the resulting pathway_id.

input_prompt.description: Detailed description of the agent and flow, 100-8000 characters.

get_pathway_generation_status.title: Get pathway generation status
get_pathway_generation_status.description: Poll a generate_pathway job. Returns ready=true and the pathway_id once the pathway is built, or an error.

list_pathway_versions.title: List pathway versions
list_pathway_versions.description: List the saved versions of a pathway with version number, name, creation time and which is latest.

get_pathway_version.title: Get a pathway version
get_pathway_version.description: Get one version of a pathway, including its nodes and edges. Version 0 is the live pathway.

version_id.description: Version number; 0 for the live pathway.

output.description: The version with nodes and edges.

create_pathway_version.title: Create a pathway version
create_pathway_version.description: Save a new version of a pathway with the given nodes and edges. Publish it to staging or production with publish_pathway_version.

output.description: The created version with id and version_number.

update_pathway_version.title: Update a pathway version
update_pathway_version.description: Replace the name, nodes and edges of an existing pathway version.

delete_pathway_version.title: Archive a pathway version
delete_pathway_version.description: Archive (delete) one version of a pathway. The live production version cannot be removed this way.

version_id.description: Id of the version to archive.

publish_pathway_version.title: Publish a pathway version
publish_pathway_version.description: Promote a pathway version to production (the default) or staging, so calls using the pathway run that version.

create_pathway_chat.title: Create a pathway chat
create_pathway_chat.description: Open a text chat session against a pathway, to test it without placing a call. Returns a chat_id to use with send_pathway_chat_message.

start_node_id.description: Node to start from instead of the pathway's start node.

pathway_version.description: Version to chat with; defaults to production.

send_pathway_chat_message.title: Send a pathway chat message
send_pathway_chat_message.description: Send a user message to a pathway chat and get the agent's replies, the current node and extracted variables.

get_pathway_chat_history.title: Get pathway chat history
get_pathway_chat_history.description: Get the full message history of a pathway chat session.

list_pathway_folders.title: List pathway folders
list_pathway_folders.description: List the folders pathways are organised into, with parent folder ids.

list_folder_pathways.title: List pathways in a folder
list_folder_pathways.description: List the pathways stored in one folder, with name, description and creation time.

create_pathway_folder.title: Create a pathway folder
create_pathway_folder.description: Create a folder for organising pathways, optionally inside a parent folder.

rename_pathway_folder.title: Rename a pathway folder
rename_pathway_folder.description: Change the name of a pathway folder; the pathways inside are unaffected.

delete_pathway_folder.title: Delete a pathway folder
delete_pathway_folder.description: Delete an empty pathway folder. Move its pathways out first with move_pathway_to_folder.

move_pathway_to_folder.title: Move a pathway to a folder
move_pathway_to_folder.description: Move a pathway into a folder, or to the root level when folder_id is omitted.

folder_id.description: Destination folder; omit for the root level.

output.description: pathway_id with old and new folder ids.

list_voices.title: List voices
list_voices.description: List every voice the account can use: Bland curated voices, your clones, library voices you added and org voices. Returns id, name, tags, engine and ratings. Pass a name or id to send_call's voice.

get_voice.title: Get a voice
get_voice.description: Get one voice's details by UUID or curated name (e.g. Karen).

voice_id.description: Voice UUID or curated voice name.

list_shared_voices.title: List shared library voices
list_shared_voices.description: Browse the public Bland voice library with search and language filters. Add one to your account with add_library_voice.

search.description: Free text over name, description and tags.

language.description: Language tag, e.g. en, es, ja.

add_library_voice.title: Add a library voice
add_library_voice.description: Add a voice from the shared public library to your organization so it can be used on calls.

rename_voice.title: Rename a voice
rename_voice.description: Change the display name of a voice you own (1-30 characters, unique in your library).

delete_voice.title: Delete a voice
delete_voice.description: Permanently delete a voice you own, such as a voice clone.

get_voice_settings.title: Get voice settings
get_voice_settings.description: Get a voice's default synthesis settings (consistency, expressiveness, language-consistency boost) and their valid ranges.

update_voice_settings.title: Update voice settings
update_voice_settings.description: Update the default synthesis settings of a voice you own. consistency and expressiveness apply to V1/V2 voices; boost_language_consistency to V3 voices.

consistency.description: V1: 0-1 (higher is more consistent); V2: 0-64 (lower is more consistent).

boost_language_consistency.description: V3 only: favour staying in one language.

rate_voice.title: Rate a voice
rate_voice.description: Give a voice a 1-5 star rating. Returns the new rating count and average.

check_voice_name_availability.title: Check voice name availability
check_voice_name_availability.description: Check whether a name is free for a new voice clone before creating one.

output.description: result true when available, with a message.

list_voice_samples.title: List voice clone samples
list_voice_samples.description: List the training samples attached to a voice clone, with transcription and duration; audio is included only when include_audio is true.

delete_voice_samples.title: Delete voice clone samples
delete_voice_samples.description: Remove training samples from a voice clone by sample id.

list_tts_models.title: List TTS models
list_tts_models.description: List Bland's text-to-speech models with their languages, sample rates, character limits and whether they support cloning.

list_speech_generations.title: List stored TTS generations
list_speech_generations.description: List stored text-to-speech generations with text, voice, format, latency and cost. Use get_speech_generation for one.

get_speech_generation.title: Get a stored TTS generation
get_speech_generation.description: Get one stored text-to-speech generation's metadata, or its raw WAV audio when format is audio.

format.description: Pass audio for the raw WAV instead of JSON.

purchase_phone_number.title: Purchase a phone number
purchase_phone_number.description: Buy a new Bland phone number (US or Canada, billed monthly), by exact number or area code. Configure its inbound agent afterwards with update_inbound_number.

phone_number.description: Exact number to buy, E.164; overrides area_code.

list_inbound_numbers.title: List inbound numbers
list_inbound_numbers.description: List the inbound phone numbers on the account with their prompt, pathway, voice and webhook configuration.

encrypted_key.description: Encrypted key of a Bring-Your-Own-Twilio account, only when working with numbers from your own Twilio account.

get_inbound_number.title: Get an inbound number
get_inbound_number.description: Get the full agent configuration of one inbound number: prompt, pathway, voice, webhook, transfer and duration settings.

phone_number.description: The inbound number; + prefix optional, US assumed without a country code.

update_inbound_number.title: Configure an inbound number's agent
update_inbound_number.description: Set how the AI agent answers calls to an inbound number: prompt or pathway, voice, first sentence, transfers, webhook, recording and more. Only the fields you pass are changed.

prompt.description: Agent instructions; not needed when pathway_id is set.

pathway_id.description: Pathway that drives calls, overriding prompt.

transfer_phone_number.description: Number to transfer to when a human is requested.

transfer_list.description: Map of department to phone number.

fallback_number.description: Number calls are forwarded to during maintenance.

memory_id.description: Memory store shared across calls to this number.

webhook.description: URL that receives call details when each call ends.

webhook_events.description: Live events to stream to the webhook.

tools.description: Custom tool definitions available to the agent.

metadata.description: Data stored on every call to this number.

citation_schema_ids.description: Citation schemas to run after calls.

interruption_threshold.description: Patience in ms before the agent responds.

block_interruptions.description: Ignore callers talking over the agent.

encrypted_key.description: Encrypted key of a Bring-Your-Own-Twilio account, only when working with numbers from your own Twilio account.

update_inbound_number_label.title: Label an inbound number
update_inbound_number_label.description: Set or clear the display label of an inbound number (max 150 characters; empty string clears it).

delete_inbound_number.title: Remove a BYOT inbound number
delete_inbound_number.description: Remove an inbound number that was imported from your own Twilio account. Requires that account's encrypted_key; Bland-purchased numbers are not removed this way.

encrypted_key.description: Encrypted key of the Twilio account that owns the number.

create_block_rules.title: Block phone numbers
create_block_rules.description: Block up to 10 numbers from reaching your inbound numbers, either globally or for one inbound number.

is_global.description: true blocks across all inbound numbers; false scopes to inbound_number.

inbound_number.description: Inbound number the block applies to; required when is_global is false.

list_block_rules.title: List block rules
list_block_rules.description: List block rules for one inbound number, or the global rules when inbound_number is omitted.

inbound_number.description: Only rules for this inbound number; omit for global rules.

get_block_rule.title: Get a block rule
get_block_rule.description: Get one block rule: the blocked number, scope, reason and whether it is active.

update_block_rule.title: Update a block rule
update_block_rule.description: Change a block rule's reason or enable/disable it without deleting it.

is_active.description: false disables the rule, true re-enables it.

delete_block_rule.title: Delete a block rule
delete_block_rule.description: Permanently delete a block rule so the number can call again.

send_sms.title: Send an SMS
send_sms.description: Send a text from one of your agent numbers to a user, starting or resuming the conversation. Give agent_message for fixed text, or omit it to have the reply generated from objective, pathway or persona. Channel can be sms, whatsapp or imessage. To post into a known conversation use send_sms_conversation_message.

agent_message.description: Exact text to send; omit to generate it.

objective.description: Goal the agent pursues in the conversation.

new_conversation.description: Archive any existing conversation and start fresh.

content_sid.description: Twilio content SID (HX...) for a template message.

metadata.description: Data returned in every webhook for this conversation.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key so a retried request does not send twice.

list_sms_numbers.title: List SMS numbers
list_sms_numbers.description: List the phone numbers configured for SMS and their SMS agent configuration (webhook, pathway, objective, timeouts).

update_sms_number.title: Configure an SMS number
update_sms_number.description: Update the SMS agent configuration of one of your numbers: objective or pathway, webhook, timeouts, summary prompt and outcomes. Only the fields you pass change.

time_out.description: Seconds of user silence before the timeout flow.

warning_time.description: Seconds before the warning message; less than time_out.

restart_after_end_call.description: Start a new conversation when the user texts after one ended.

disposition_ids.description: Outcome ids to run when conversations end.

citation_schema_ids.description: Citation schemas to extract when conversations end.

create_sms_conversation.title: Create an SMS conversation
create_sms_conversation.description: Create or seed an SMS conversation with a stored message and pathway position without sending anything. Use send_sms to actually text the user.

current_node_id.description: Node the conversation is positioned at.

new_conversation.description: Archive any active conversation between the numbers first.

list_sms_conversations.title: List SMS conversations
list_sms_conversations.description: List SMS conversations, newest first by default, with sorting and filters (JSON-encoded array of {field, operator, value}).

sort_by.description: Sort field, e.g. created_at, updated_at, user_number, message_count.

filters.description: JSON-encoded array of filter objects, e.g. [{"field":"user_number","operator":"eq","value":"+1..."}].

get_sms_conversation.title: Get an SMS conversation
get_sms_conversation.description: Get one SMS conversation with its messages, variables and pathway position.

update_sms_conversation.title: Update an SMS conversation
update_sms_conversation.description: Mark an SMS conversation active or inactive.

send_sms_conversation_message.title: Send a message on an SMS conversation
send_sms_conversation_message.description: Send a text into an existing conversation, attributed to a human rep (default) or the agent. Use send_sms when you only know the phone numbers.

message.description: Text to send, up to 1600 characters.

sender.description: Who the message is attributed to.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key so a retry does not send twice.

output.description: message_id and whether human handoff is active.

handoff_sms_conversation.title: Hand an SMS conversation to a human
handoff_sms_conversation.description: Pause the AI on a conversation and hand it to a human rep; later replies are relayed instead of answered. Use resume_sms_conversation to give it back.

actor.description: Who took it (email or rep id).

webhook.description: Replacement webhook URL for relayed messages.

notify_number.description: Number to text a heads-up to, E.164.

output.description: The conversation and whether a handoff was already active.

resume_sms_conversation.title: Resume an SMS conversation
resume_sms_conversation.description: Give a handed-off conversation back to the AI agent, optionally sending a message or generating the next reply immediately.

message.description: Fixed message the agent sends on resuming; not with generate_reply.

generate_reply.description: Generate and send the agent's next turn now.

end_sms_conversation.title: End an SMS conversation
end_sms_conversation.description: End an SMS conversation, firing the ended webhook, summary and outcomes.

reason.description: Reason surfaced on the ended webhook, max 500 characters.

delete_sms_messages.title: Delete SMS messages
delete_sms_messages.description: Mark specific messages in a conversation as deleted.

message_ids.description: Ids of the messages to delete.

delete_sms_conversation.title: Delete an SMS conversation
delete_sms_conversation.description: Permanently delete a conversation and all its messages. Use end_sms_conversation to close it while keeping history.

get_sms_conversation_webhook.title: Get SMS conversation webhook log
get_sms_conversation_webhook.description: Get the post-conversation webhook delivery for an SMS conversation: URL, payload and time.

analyze_sms_conversation.title: Analyze an SMS conversation
analyze_sms_conversation.description: Extract variables from an SMS conversation using a citation schema. Returns the extracted values with citations and confidence.

create_text_knowledge_base.title: Create a knowledge base from text
create_text_knowledge_base.description: Create a knowledge base item from raw text (up to 1MB) that agents can search during calls. Use create_web_knowledge_base to scrape URLs instead.

output.description: The new knowledge base item with id and status.

create_web_knowledge_base.title: Create a knowledge base from websites
create_web_knowledge_base.description: Create a knowledge base item by scraping up to 100 URLs. Use discover_sitemap_urls to find a site's pages first.

output.description: The new knowledge base item with id and status.

discover_sitemap_urls.title: Discover sitemap URLs
discover_sitemap_urls.description: Find a website's page URLs from its sitemap, to choose which to pass to create_web_knowledge_base.

list_knowledge_bases.title: List knowledge bases
list_knowledge_bases.description: List the organization's knowledge base items with name, type, status and sources, paginated.

get_knowledge_base.title: Get a knowledge base
get_knowledge_base.description: Get one knowledge base item with its status, type, sources and any processing error.

update_knowledge_base.title: Update a knowledge base
update_knowledge_base.description: Rename a knowledge base item or change its description. The content itself is not changed.

delete_knowledge_base.title: Delete a knowledge base
delete_knowledge_base.description: Permanently delete a knowledge base item.

query_knowledge_base.title: Ask a knowledge base
query_knowledge_base.description: Ask a question against a knowledge base item and get an answer with the source passages. Pass prior turns in messages for follow-ups.

knowledge_base_id.description: Id of the item to query.

messages.description: Conversation turns, e.g. [{"role": "user", "content": "What is the refund policy?"}].

list_tools.title: List custom tools
list_tools.description: List the custom tools agents can call during calls, with integration, action, input schema and settings.

get_tool.title: Get a custom tool
get_tool.description: Get one custom tool (TL-... id) with its full configuration.

create_tool.title: Create a custom tool
create_tool.description: Create a tool agents can call mid-call through an integration (REST API, custom code, Slack, Salesforce, HubSpot, Calendly, Cal.com, Notion, Bland SMS). Returns the tool id to reference in send_call tools.

name.description: Name the agent sees when deciding to use the tool.

description.description: What the tool does, shown to the agent.

input_schema.description: OpenAI function-calling parameter schema the agent fills in.

body.description: Request body template sent to the integration; may reference {{input.x}}.

speech.description: What the agent says while the tool runs.

response_data.description: Values to extract from the response: [{name, data (JSON path), context}].

resource_id.description: Connected resource (e.g. Slack workspace) the tool is scoped to.

update_tool.title: Update a custom tool
update_tool.description: Update any field of a custom tool; only the fields you pass change.

name.description: Name the agent sees when deciding to use the tool.

description.description: What the tool does, shown to the agent.

input_schema.description: OpenAI function-calling parameter schema the agent fills in.

body.description: Request body template sent to the integration; may reference {{input.x}}.

speech.description: What the agent says while the tool runs.

response_data.description: Values to extract from the response: [{name, data (JSON path), context}].

resource_id.description: Connected resource (e.g. Slack workspace) the tool is scoped to.

delete_tool.title: Delete a custom tool
delete_tool.description: Permanently delete a custom tool; calls and agents referencing it can no longer use it.

list_tool_logs.title: List tool execution logs
list_tool_logs.description: List executions of custom tools with status, call, timing and payload sizes, filterable by tool, call, status and date. Use to debug tool failures.

list_web_agents.title: List web agents
list_web_agents.description: List the web (browser) voice agents on the account with their settings.

create_web_agent.title: Create a web agent
create_web_agent.description: Create a voice agent that talks to users in the browser. Returns the agent id; issue per-session tokens with authorize_web_agent_call.

pathway_id.description: Pathway that drives the agent, overriding prompt.

webhook.description: URL receiving call data after each web call.

tools.description: Custom tool definitions available to the agent.

dynamic_data.description: External API data to load into the agent.

update_web_agent.title: Update a web agent
update_web_agent.description: Update a web agent's prompt, voice, pathway and other settings.

pathway_id.description: Pathway that drives the agent, overriding prompt.

webhook.description: URL receiving call data after each web call.

tools.description: Custom tool definitions available to the agent.

dynamic_data.description: External API data to load into the agent.

authorize_web_agent_call.title: Authorize a web agent call
authorize_web_agent_call.description: Create a single-use session token a browser client uses to talk to a web agent, optionally with variables for the session.

delete_web_agent.title: Delete a web agent
delete_web_agent.description: Permanently delete a web agent; browser sessions can no longer be authorized for it.

list_prompts.title: List saved prompts
list_prompts.description: List the prompts saved on the account for reuse in calls.

get_prompt.title: Get a saved prompt
get_prompt.description: Get one saved prompt's text, name and last update time.

create_prompt.title: Save a prompt
create_prompt.description: Store a prompt for future calls, with an optional reference name.

list_personas.title: List personas
list_personas.description: List personas (reusable agent presets usable on calls, SMS and inbound numbers), paginated.

get_persona.title: Get a persona
get_persona.description: Get one persona with its production and draft version ids and settings.

create_persona.title: Create a persona
create_persona.description: Create a persona: a reusable agent configuration (voice, prompts, pathways, knowledge) that send_call, send_sms and inbound numbers can reference by persona_id.

call_config.description: Call settings: voice, record, language, background, max_duration, wait_for_greeting, interruption_threshold.

default_tools.description: Default tool definitions enabled for the persona.

pathway_conditions.description: Routing conditions: [{name, prompt, pathway_id, pathway_version, start_node_id}].

kb_ids.description: Knowledge base ids connected to the persona.

update_persona.title: Update a persona
update_persona.description: Update a persona's configuration. Changes land on its draft version; promote them with promote_persona_version.

call_config.description: Call settings: voice, record, language, background, max_duration, wait_for_greeting, interruption_threshold.

default_tools.description: Default tool definitions enabled for the persona.

pathway_conditions.description: Routing conditions: [{name, prompt, pathway_id, pathway_version, start_node_id}].

kb_ids.description: Knowledge base ids connected to the persona.

delete_persona.title: Delete a persona
delete_persona.description: Delete a persona. Fails while phone numbers use it unless force is true.

force.description: Delete even if numbers use it.

attach_persona_numbers.title: Attach numbers to a persona
attach_persona_numbers.description: Attach inbound phone numbers to a persona so calls to them use its configuration.

detach_persona_numbers.title: Detach numbers from a persona
detach_persona_numbers.description: Detach inbound phone numbers from a persona.

list_persona_versions.title: List persona versions
list_persona_versions.description: List a persona's versions (draft and production) with their prompts and configuration.

get_persona_version.title: Get a persona version
get_persona_version.description: Get one persona version by id, or by the aliases draft or production.

promote_persona_version.title: Promote a persona draft
promote_persona_version.description: Promote a persona's draft version to production so live calls use it.

list_contacts.title: List contacts
list_contacts.description: List the organization's contacts with their identifiers (phone, email, external id) and memory entities.

find_contact.title: Find a contact
find_contact.description: Look up a contact by phone number, email or external id (at least one).

get_contact.title: Get a contact
get_contact.description: Get one contact with identifiers, metadata and memories.

resolve_contact.title: Find or create a contact
resolve_contact.description: Find a contact by phone, email or external id, creating it if none exists. Returns the contact and whether it was created.

update_contact.title: Update a contact
update_contact.description: Update a contact's name, add or change its email or external id, and merge metadata.

merge_contacts.title: Merge contacts
merge_contacts.description: Merge a duplicate contact into a primary one; calls, conversations and memory move over and the duplicate is deleted.

create_contact_memory.title: Create contact memory
create_contact_memory.description: Create a memory record for a contact scoped to a persona or agent number, so conversations there remember the contact.

persona_id.description: Persona the memory is scoped to; give this or agent_number.

agent_number.description: Agent number the memory is scoped to; give this or persona_id.

get_contact_memory.title: Get contact memory
get_contact_memory.description: Get a contact memory record: summary, facts, recent messages and open items.

memory_id.description: Id of the contact memory record.

list_contact_memory_messages.title: List contact memory messages
list_contact_memory_messages.description: List the recent cross-channel messages (calls and SMS) held in a contact memory record.

memory_id.description: Id of the contact memory record.

output.description: Messages with role, content, channel and timestamp.

update_contact_memory_summary.title: Replace contact memory summary
update_contact_memory_summary.description: Overwrite the conversation summary stored in a contact memory record.

memory_id.description: Id of the contact memory record.

update_contact_memory_facts.title: Merge contact memory facts
update_contact_memory_facts.description: Merge key-value facts into a contact memory record; new keys are added and existing keys updated.

memory_id.description: Id of the contact memory record.

get_memory_context.title: Get memory context
get_memory_context.description: Get the memory context a contact sees at the start of a conversation with a persona or agent number: summary, facts and recent messages.

persona_id.description: Persona the memory is scoped to; give this or agent_number.

agent_number.description: Agent number the memory is scoped to; give this or persona_id.

get_memory_changes.title: Get memory changes
get_memory_changes.description: Get what memory was captured or updated during one call or SMS conversation.

call_id.description: Call id; give this or conversation_id.

reset_contact_memory.title: Reset contact memory
reset_contact_memory.description: Permanently delete all memory for a contact scoped to a persona or agent number.

persona_id.description: Persona the memory is scoped to; give this or agent_number.

agent_number.description: Agent number the memory is scoped to; give this or persona_id.

list_memories.title: List memory stores
list_memories.description: List the memory stores that group call history by phone number across calls.

get_memory.title: Get a memory store
get_memory.description: Get a memory store with the users (phone numbers) in it and their call counts.

output.description: The memory store and its users.

create_memory.title: Create a memory store
create_memory.description: Create a memory store; attach it to an inbound number (memory_id) so callers are remembered across calls.

rename_memory.title: Rename a memory store
rename_memory.description: Change the name of a memory store; its users and calls are unaffected.

delete_memory.title: Delete a memory store
delete_memory.description: Permanently delete a memory store and all its users, calls and metadata.

get_memory_user.title: Get a memory user
get_memory_user.description: Get the memory held for one phone number in a memory store: summary, metadata, call count and calls.

search_memory_user_calls.title: Search a memory user's calls
search_memory_user_calls.description: List the calls recorded for one phone number within a memory store, with summaries.

add_memory_user.title: Add a user to a memory store
add_memory_user.description: Add a phone number to a memory store with optional metadata and an initial summary.

update_memory_user.title: Update a memory user
update_memory_user.description: Update the metadata and summary stored for a phone number in a memory store.

remove_memory_user.title: Remove a user from a memory store
remove_memory_user.description: Remove a phone number and all its data from a memory store.

add_call_to_memory.title: Add a call to a memory store
add_call_to_memory.description: Add an existing call to a memory store so it becomes part of that caller's history.

remove_call_from_memory.title: Remove a call from a memory store
remove_call_from_memory.description: Remove one call from a user's history in a memory store.

phone_number.description: Phone number the call belongs to.

list_citation_schemas.title: List citation schemas
list_citation_schemas.description: List the citation schemas used to extract structured data from call transcripts.

get_citation_schema.title: Get a citation schema
get_citation_schema.description: Get one citation schema with its variable definitions.

create_citation_schema.title: Create a citation schema
create_citation_schema.description: Create a schema defining variables to extract from call transcripts after calls. Reference it via citation_schema_ids on calls, numbers or SMS.

schema.description: Configuration of variables, groupings and conditions.

update_citation_schema.title: Update a citation schema
update_citation_schema.description: Update a citation schema's name, description or configuration; schema replaces the existing configuration.

backfill_citation_schemas.title: Apply citation schemas to past calls
backfill_citation_schemas.description: Run saved (schema_ids) or inline (schema) citation schemas over existing calls or SMS conversations to extract data retroactively.

schema.description: Inline schema instead of saved ones.

output.description: Workflow status and, for conversations, the results.

list_guard_rails.title: List guard rails
list_guard_rails.description: List compliance guard rails, optionally for one persona, pathway or inbound number.

source_id.description: Only guard rails attached to this source (UUID).

get_guard_rail.title: Get a guard rail
get_guard_rail.description: Get one guard rail with its type, prompt, config and attachments.

create_guard_rail.title: Create a guard rail
create_guard_rail.description: Create a guard rail that monitors calls for violations: a TCPA type (e.g. tcpa:ai_disclosure) or custom with a detection prompt, attached to personas, pathways or inbound numbers.

type.description: custom, or a TCPA type such as tcpa:ai_disclosure, tcpa:recording_disclosure, tcpa:self_introduction.

config.description: Configuration, e.g. {"end_seconds": 30} for time-based TCPA rails.

update_guard_rail.title: Update a guard rail
update_guard_rail.description: Update a guard rail's name, description, prompt, config or attachments (attachments replace existing ones).

delete_guard_rail.title: Delete a guard rail
delete_guard_rail.description: Delete a guard rail so it no longer monitors the personas, pathways or numbers it was attached to.
